script_text: The stars are about to shake your foundation this week, Virgo. Sun enters your 7th House of Partnership as the Autumnal Equinox arrives, spotlighting your closest relationships and demanding the honest conversations you've avoided. Mercury, ruling planet of Earth-sign Virgo, forms a tense square with Pluto, stirring buried career dynamics — a promotion or difficult boss confrontation surfaces Monday through Wednesday. Mid-week, Venus trines Jupiter in your 10th House, opening a golden doorway for professional recognition and financial reward you cannot ignore. By Thursday, the Moon enters your 4th Home sector, softening everything — love deepens, and a family matter brings unexpected closure by the weekend. Monday is your power day because the Mercury-Pluto square forces career clarity. Thursday is your love day because the Venus-Jupiter trine floods your 10th House with abundance. Trust Mercury's guidance and journal every intuitive thought Tuesday night. Follow for daily updates.
